create_RobertaTokenizer: create a RobertaTokenizer instance with vocab and merges files for RoBERTa text tokenization
build_inputs_with_special_tokens: build model inputs from sequences by adding RoBERTa special tokens <s> and </s>
get_special_tokens_mask: get a special tokens mask list marking special tokens with 1 and sequence tokens with 0
create_token_type_ids_from_sequences: create token type id masks for sequence pairs returning zeros since RoBERTa uses no token type ids
prepare_for_tokenization: prepare text for tokenization by optionally adding a leading space before the first word
